decoder_experiment.scope: Matched geometry; graph time per GEMM, ms.
decoder_experiment.decoder_correctness: Both candidates matched all 65,536 E4M3FN and E8M0 pairs against CPU BF16, including signed zeros; full outputs and changed-input graph replay passed on all four workloads.

decoder_changes.ldexp: Decode E4M3FN as in the lesson. Replace the FP32 E8M0 scale construction and multiply with llvm.intr_ldexp(value, scale_byte - 127). Scale byte 255 yields NaN, then round to BF16.
decoder_changes.ldexp_subtract: Also decode magnitudes below eight as the FP32 normal with magnitude code increased by eight, minus 2^-6. Insert the E4M3FN sign after the subtraction.

decoder_experiment.replay_method: 7 shuffled batches, 10 graph replays per batch, 32 GEMMs per replay. GPU events record per-GEMM time.
